tokens.name: ground-top
tokens.usage: Top of the window's purple gradient, like the official editor. Background only; no text straight on the gradient without a panel.

tokens.name: ground-bottom
tokens.usage: Bottom of the window's purple gradient.

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Solid background where the gradient doesn't fit (small windows, system dialogs).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Wells: file lists, signal chain area, search fields, MIDI monitor. The graphite black of the official editor's list boxes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels and effect blocks: the slightly purple graphite of the official editor's panels.

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Top-level cards (IR, AM2Data) and panel headers.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Buttons, knob tracks, selects: the official editor's button gray. Text on it: ink or ink-muted.

tokens.name: control-hover
tokens.usage: Button and row hover.

tokens.name: control-active
tokens.usage: Pressed button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and panel outlines. Decorative.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input border and selection focus on surface and surface-raised (3:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Main text: button labels, knob values, names. On every surface and on control.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, labels inside knobs, metadata. 5:1 on control, 6.7:1 on surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Only disabled text and items outside a filter. Not for text that must be read.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: The Tank-G's color: knob arcs, toggles that are on, selected file name, primary. As text, on any surface (8:1 on surface-raised).

tokens.name: amber-ink
tokens.usage: Accent as text: alias of amber, so a future theme can change only the text.

tokens.name: amber-soft
tokens.usage: Selection background: row, preset cell, active palette item.

tokens.name: amber-glow
tokens.usage: Glow (drop-shadow) of active arcs, LEDs and cables. Never as a solid fill.

tokens.name: on-amber
tokens.usage: Text and icon on an accent fill (primary button).

tokens.name: toggle-off
tokens.usage: Track of a toggle that is off, the official editor's light gray.

tokens.name: toggle-thumb
tokens.usage: The toggle's white thumb, on and off.

tokens.name: chartreuse
tokens.usage: The olive yellow of the official editor's Color button. Only on the LED color button.

tokens.name: on-chartreuse
tokens.usage: Text on chartreuse. The official editor uses white (1.9:1, unreadable); here it is dark.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Connected, saved. Always with a word or icon. As text, on the surfaces.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Success tag background, behind ok text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error tag background.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: Modified and not saved, saving.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Warning tag background.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Dark purple veil behind the command palette.

tokens.name: display-bg
tokens.usage: 7-segment display bezel.

tokens.name: display-on
tokens.usage: Lit display segment (6:1 on display-bg).

tokens.name: display-off
tokens.usage: Unlit display segment.

tokens.name: tolex
tokens.usage: Amp and cab body in the signal chain (the black vinyl).

tokens.name: grille
tokens.usage: Amp and cab grille cloth.

tokens.name: metal
tokens.usage: Hardware, front panel and footswitch in the illustrations.

tokens.name: cable
tokens.usage: Cable jacket between the chain blocks.

tokens.name: led-red
tokens.usage: Red LED: preset color and the chain pedals' LED. Only as light (dot, LED); never as text.

tokens.name: led-orange
tokens.usage: Orange LED: preset color and the chain pedals' LED. Only as light (dot, LED); never as text.

tokens.name: led-yellow
tokens.usage: Yellow LED: preset color and the chain pedals' LED. Only as light (dot, LED); never as text.

tokens.name: led-green

tokens.name: led-cyan
tokens.usage: Cyan LED: preset color and the chain pedals' LED. Only as light (dot, LED); never as text.

tokens.name: led-blue
tokens.usage: Blue LED: preset color and the chain pedals' LED. Only as light (dot, LED); never as text.

tokens.name: led-purple
tokens.usage: Purple LED: preset color and the chain pedals' LED. Only as light (dot, LED); never as text.

tokens.name: led-white
tokens.usage: White LED: preset color and the chain pedals' LED. Only as light (dot, LED); never as text.
